name: New line - Motorola edge 2026 $5.99 - Extra 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: easygoing, mid-30s.
scripted_messages: Hey there! I'm thinking about the Motorola edge 2026, which shows at $5.99 a month with a new line and no trade-in. I'd put it on Extra 2.0. What's the monthly total, and does the plan include talk and text in Canada and Mexico?
Awesome. Is 100GB the high speed limit before slowing?
Quick one, how many GB of hotspot do I get?
Perfect, thanks! You were friendly and really easy to talk to.
That's all. Have a great one, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
